stories.title: North Wales Police urge drivers to check tyres, brakes and lights for Road Safety Week
stories.summary: Officers are reminding motorists of the legal 1.6mm tread limit and the rules on brakes, lights and windscreens as darker, colder months arrive.

stories.title: Three Mold restaurants given top food hygiene rating
stories.summary: Three Mold restaurants have been given the top food hygiene rating of five. Alexander’s on High Street, Belvedere Italian Restaurant on Wrexham Street and Eastern Red on Grosvenor Street were inspected on 4 and 5 November. stories.title: North Wales Police warns of criminals using AI to promote fake investment schemes
stories.summary: Criminals are using deepfake videos and images to make fake investment offers look genuine, with over-60s most affected, the force says.

stories.title: Guaranteed jobs scheme for young people extended to Flintshire as claimant numbers rise
stories.summary: The number of 18 to 24 year olds in Flintshire claiming unemployment-related benefits has risen by a quarter in a year, as a UK government scheme guaranteeing young people a paid job is extended to the county for the first time. Office for National Statistics figures show 645 people aged 18 to 24 in Flintshire

stories.title: Welsh Labour leader Ken Skates says sorry to Wales for party’s worst ever election result
stories.summary: Welsh Labour leader Ken Skates has apologised to the people of Wales for what he called the worst result in Welsh Labour’s history. Speaking at the party’s conference in Llandudno, the Fflint Wrecsam MS said: To the people of Wales and on behalf of my Party I am sorry. I am sorry we fell short
